Buying sealed Pokemon product

What sealed means here

Factory sealed and unopened: booster boxes, Elite Trainer Boxes and booster bundles. Each listing shows how many are in stock.

English and Japanese boxes

Japanese and English boxes are not the same size, and pack counts differ from set to set. If a listing doesn't say how many packs are inside, ask before you buy.
